title: Scale, Concentration, and Entry Timing in the Shopify App Ecosystem: A Longitudinal Study of Platform Governance and Application Survival
abstract: arXiv:2608.23771v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Shopify marketplace hosts more than 16,000 active third-party applications, serving 2.7 million active merchant stores generating an estimated \$706 billion in annual sales, yet little empirical evidence exists on its structure and adoption drivers. We analyse it using a September 2025 snapshot of all 24,826 applications, a weekly panel of 7,708 applications over 366 weeks (February 2019 to March 2026), and listing histories reconstructed from the Internet Archive. Across 55 established functional categories, over half were low-concentration and 20\% highly concentrated, with larger categories consistently less concentrated. Later entrants grew faster than early movers in 88\% of the 50 analysed categories, persisting across seven years of quarterly re-estimations, with early movers on net losing detected installations whilst late movers gained them. Platform governance reshaped competition asymmetrically: Shopify's entry into chat r

translated_title: Shopify应用生态系统中的规模、集中度与进入时机：平台治理与应用生存的纵向研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23771v1 公告类型：新 摘要：Shopify市场托管着超过16,000个活跃的第三方应用程序，服务于270万家活跃商户商店，年销售额估计达7060亿美元，然而对其结构和采用驱动因素的实证证据仍然匮乏。我们利用2025年9月所有24,826个应用程序的快照、覆盖366周（2019年2月至2026年3月）的7,708个应用程序的周度面板数据，以及从互联网档案馆重建的列表历史进行了分析。在55个已确立的功能类别中，超过一半属于低集中度，20%属于高度集中，而较大的类别始终集中度较低。在分析的50个类别中，88%的类别中后期进入者比早期行动者增长更快，这一现象在七年间的季度重新估计中持续存在，早期行动者净失去检测到的安装量，而后期进入者则获得安装量。平台治理不对称地重塑了竞争：Shopify进入聊天领域对应用生存产生了显著影响。
tldr: 本文通过对Shopify应用生态系统的纵向分析，发现后期进入者通常比早期行动者增长更快，且平台治理（如Shopify进入聊天领域）会不对称地改变竞争格局，影响应用生存。
en_tdlr: This study longitudinally analyzes the Shopify app ecosystem, finding that later entrants generally grow faster than early movers, and platform governance (e.g., Shopify's entry into chat) asymmetrically reshapes competition and affects application survival.
